items.title: President Barrow Promises Relief by October as Protests Over Power Crisis Mount
items.summary: By Dawda Baldeh President Adama Barrow has addressed the nation following widespread public protests over severe power cuts across the Greater Banjul Area, promising that The Gambia’s electricity supply will improve by the end of October 2026. Addressing citizens in a national...
items.author: Hadram Hydara
